update_llc_test_checks: update LLVM llc-based test cases with new FileCheck patterns from a test file
run_llc_test_update: run the update_llc_test_checks script on a single LLVM IR test file to regenerate FileCheck assertions
update_single_function: update FileCheck assertions for a single function in an LLVM IR test file using --function flag
scrub_x86_rip_diffs: use x86 scrub mode to reduce diffs between various x86 subtargets in generated FileCheck patterns
update_multiple_tests: update FileCheck assertions across multiple LLVM IR test files in a single invocation
